answers.question: How many new postcards have I added to my collection since I started collecting again?
lines: [2023-08-11] User: I didn't know there were so many online communities dedicated to collecting and photography. I'll definitely check some of these out. By the way, speaking of my collection, I was wondering if you could help me generate a list of my postcards? I've added 17 new ones since I started collecting again, and I'd like to keep track of them.

[2023-11-30] User: I'm really excited to host this collector's gathering and share my passion with like-minded enthusiasts. Speaking of which, I just realized I've added 25 new postcards to my collection since I started collecting again. It's amazing how fast my collection has grown! By the way, do you have any recommendations for creating a simple, yet effective display for my postcard collection?
